The two active experiments both target output quality rather than feed parameters, so no feed-side intervention is warranted. Yesterday's full-day metrics (37 articles, sci-tech 38%, multi-source 10, 6 regions) were strong across the board; today's partial-day numbers are within expected range for a heavy-politics news day, with cycle duration notably faster at 774s avg vs the previous 1682s.
